utterance: When is Cubbon Park closed to traffic?
passages: Cubbon Park is a 300-acre green space in central Bengaluru, laid out in 1870.
The park is closed to vehicle traffic on Sundays and on public holidays, when the internal roads are given over to walkers and cyclists.

utterance: How do auto-rickshaw night fares work?
passages: Auto-rickshaw fares in Bengaluru begin with a minimum fare covering the first two kilometres, with a per-kilometre rate applied after that.
A night surcharge applies between 22:00 and 05:00, and drivers are required to run the meter at all times.
